mechanism: Verapamil (calcium channel blocker) may potentiate the hypocalcemic effects of zoledronic acid (bisphosphonate), increasing risk of severe hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances; both agents can also cause bradycardia and cardiac conduction abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and magnesium levels closely; assess cardiac function and heart rate; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider alternative antianginal agent if hypocalcemia develops.
